complaints.description: The contact owns a 2017 Maserati Ghibli. The contact stated that while driving at various speeds, the rear end of the vehicle made an abnormal tinging sound. The contact related the failure to NHTSA Campaign Number: 16V856000(Power Train). The dealer was notified of the failure and informed the contact that the VIN was not included in the recall. The vehicle was not diagnosed or repaired. The manufacturer was notified of the failure, but no assistance was provided. The failure mileage mileage was approximately 37,600.

There is a recall for a rear differential issue and Maserati had previously repaired the differential. However, the problem has persisted and I have about 41k miles on the vehicle and already having the same issue. There is a whining noise in the rear along with a leaking rear differential. Both signs of the original problem. Maserati has stated that the repair has already been done but this raises a serious safety concern as it could result in the rear differential locking up and causing an accident.

Finally the car started but I couldn’t get it to go over 15 mph. The car has been to the shop twice for service. Once was an electrical and the other time they couldn’t find nothing wrong with it. They said it just needed service. I serviced the vehicle as recommended and now it back doing the same thing again.

Sitting at at red light with the start/stop system on, as I release the break pedal on a green light, the gear automatically has shifted to park. The car shows no signs that it has turned off or warnings that it has shifted gears on its own. I have to manually change gear to drive to get the car to move. I am aware that the recall was done for this issue but there has been no successful resolution to the problem. The car was taken to Rusnak Pasadena on July 21, 2021 and since they could not duplicate the concern, there was nothing done. The car was then taken to Maserati of Puente Hills as the issue continued. As per the dealership, on their maserati system, it shows that my car did not qualify for their recall and it would not be considered to be a manufacturing issue. This is a major safety concern as it can cause an accident

The vehicle was manufactured with laminated glass for all windows and the glass is delaminating and forming bubbles around glass edges which compromises the integrity of the glass. On my vehicle, it affects all 4 windows and both front and rear windshields. This issue is widely reported on forums and group message boards and seems to affect all years of the Maserati Ghibli from 2014+.  I have inquired with a local independent shop and was told that this is a safety concern and to try to reach out to the dealership. Reaching out to the dealership, I have not received a response. Others have said they had mixed results with the dealerships replacing their glass even with warranty. Others out of warranty were denied replacement or were told it is normal and not to worry.

recalls.subject: Software error may cause Shift to Neutral or Stall
recalls.summary: Maserati North America, Inc. (Maserati) is recalling certain 2017 Quattroporte vehicles equipped with V6 engines and Maserati Ghibli vehicles.  Due to an engine software problem, at slow speeds such as stop-and-go traffic, the transmission may unexpectedly shift into neutral or park, or the engine may shut off.
recalls.consequence: If the transmission shifts into neutral or park unexpectedly, or if the engine shuts down without warning, it can increase the risk of a crash.
recalls.correctiveAction: Maserati will notify owners, and dealers will re-flash the software for the engine control module, free of charge.  The recall is expected to begin May 2018.  Owners may contact Maserati customer service at 1-877-696-2737.  Maserati's number for this recall is 365.
recalls.notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

recalls.subject: Seat Wiring Harness may Short Circuit
recalls.summary: Maserati North America, Inc. (Maserati) is recalling certain 2014-2017 Quattroporte and Ghibli, and 2017 Levante vehicles.  Adjusting the front seats may cause the seat wiring harness to rub, possibly resulting in an electrical short.
recalls.consequence: An electrical short can increase the risk of a fire.
recalls.correctiveAction: Maserati will notify owners, and dealers will inspect the vehicles, replacing the seat wiring harness, as necessary, free of charge.  The recall began June 26, 2017.  Owners may contact Maserati customer service at 1-877-696-2737.  Maserati's number for this recall is 342.
recalls.notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

recalls.subject: Rear Differential Pinion Nut Improperly Torqued
recalls.summary: Maserati North America, Inc. (Maserati) is recalling certain model year 2017 Quattroporte and Ghibli vehicles manufactured July 1, 2016, to October 12, 2016.  The rear differential unit pinion nut may not have been properly tightened, allowing the pinion nut to loosen.
recalls.consequence: A loose pinion gear may bind, possibly resulting in the rear wheels locking up and increasing the risk of a crash.
recalls.correctiveAction: Maserati will notify owners, and dealers will inspect the rear differential unit pinion nut torque, and, as necessary, replace the rear differential unit, free of charge.  The recall began on December 30, 2016.  Owners may contact Maserati customer service at 1-877-696-2737.  Maserati's number for this recall is 328.
recalls.notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

recalls.subject: Tire Sidewalls may Crack
recalls.summary: Maserati North America, Inc. (Maserati) is recalling certain model year 2017 Ghibli and Quattroporte vehicles and one model year 2016 Ghibli vehicle manufactured February 29, 2016, to October 29, 2016.  These vehicles are equipped with certain Pirelli P Zero All Season tires, size 275/40R19 101W, that may develop cracks in their lower sidewall, possibly resulting in a loss of air.
recalls.consequence: A loss of air may result in tire failure or a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash.
recalls.correctiveAction: Maserati will notify owners, and dealers will replace the affected tires, free of charge.  The recall began on December 30, 2016.  Owners may contact Maserati customer service at 1-877-696-2737.  Maserati's number for this recall is 324.
recalls.notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

recalls.subject: Back-Up Camera Disabled in Very Cold Temperatures
recalls.summary: Maserati North America, Inc. (Maserati) is recalling certain model year 2017 Quattroporte, Ghible, and Levante vehicles manufactured July 1, 2016, to November 14, 2016.  In temperatures below freezing, the entertainment telematics module (ETM) may place itself in a protection mode, disabling the back-up camera.
recalls.consequence: If the back-up camera is inoperable, it may be more difficult for the operator to see people or objects behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of injury or crash.
recalls.correctiveAction: Maserati will notify owners, and dealers will update the ETM software, free of charge.  The recall began on December 30, 2016.  Owners may contact Maserati customer service at 1-877-696-2737.  Maserati's number for this recall is 327.
recalls.notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

recalls.subject: Software error may cause Shift to Neutral or Stall
recalls.summary: Maserati North America, Inc. (Maserati) is recalling certain 2017 Quattroporte vehicles equipped with V6 engines and Maserati Ghibli vehicles.  Due to an engine software problem, at slow speeds such as stop-and-go traffic, the transmission may unexpectedly shift into neutral or park, or the engine may shut off.
recalls.consequence: If the transmission shifts into neutral or park unexpectedly, or if the engine shuts down without warning, it can increase the risk of a crash.
recalls.correctiveAction: Maserati will notify owners, and dealers will re-flash the software for the engine control module, free of charge.  The recall is expected to begin May 2018.  Owners may contact Maserati customer service at 1-877-696-2737.  Maserati's number for this recall is 365.
recalls.notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

recalls.subject: Seat Wiring Harness may Short Circuit
recalls.summary: Maserati North America, Inc. (Maserati) is recalling certain 2014-2017 Quattroporte and Ghibli, and 2017 Levante vehicles.  Adjusting the front seats may cause the seat wiring harness to rub, possibly resulting in an electrical short.
recalls.consequence: An electrical short can increase the risk of a fire.
recalls.correctiveAction: Maserati will notify owners, and dealers will inspect the vehicles, replacing the seat wiring harness, as necessary, free of charge.  The recall began June 26, 2017.  Owners may contact Maserati customer service at 1-877-696-2737.  Maserati's number for this recall is 342.
recalls.notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

recalls.subject: Rear Differential Pinion Nut Improperly Torqued
recalls.summary: Maserati North America, Inc. (Maserati) is recalling certain model year 2017 Quattroporte and Ghibli vehicles manufactured July 1, 2016, to October 12, 2016.  The rear differential unit pinion nut may not have been properly tightened, allowing the pinion nut to loosen.
recalls.consequence: A loose pinion gear may bind, possibly resulting in the rear wheels locking up and increasing the risk of a crash.
recalls.correctiveAction: Maserati will notify owners, and dealers will inspect the rear differential unit pinion nut torque, and, as necessary, replace the rear differential unit, free of charge.  The recall began on December 30, 2016.  Owners may contact Maserati customer service at 1-877-696-2737.  Maserati's number for this recall is 328.
recalls.notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

recalls.subject: Tire Sidewalls may Crack
recalls.summary: Maserati North America, Inc. (Maserati) is recalling certain model year 2017 Ghibli and Quattroporte vehicles and one model year 2016 Ghibli vehicle manufactured February 29, 2016, to October 29, 2016.  These vehicles are equipped with certain Pirelli P Zero All Season tires, size 275/40R19 101W, that may develop cracks in their lower sidewall, possibly resulting in a loss of air.
recalls.consequence: A loss of air may result in tire failure or a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash.
recalls.correctiveAction: Maserati will notify owners, and dealers will replace the affected tires, free of charge.  The recall began on December 30, 2016.  Owners may contact Maserati customer service at 1-877-696-2737.  Maserati's number for this recall is 324.
recalls.notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.

recalls.subject: Back-Up Camera Disabled in Very Cold Temperatures
recalls.summary: Maserati North America, Inc. (Maserati) is recalling certain model year 2017 Quattroporte, Ghible, and Levante vehicles manufactured July 1, 2016, to November 14, 2016.  In temperatures below freezing, the entertainment telematics module (ETM) may place itself in a protection mode, disabling the back-up camera.
recalls.consequence: If the back-up camera is inoperable, it may be more difficult for the operator to see people or objects behind the vehicle, increasing the risk of injury or crash.
recalls.correctiveAction: Maserati will notify owners, and dealers will update the ETM software, free of charge.  The recall began on December 30, 2016.  Owners may contact Maserati customer service at 1-877-696-2737.  Maserati's number for this recall is 327.
recalls.notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.
